goal: Projects can pin a tagged agent-ledger release whose ledger-verify Action passes stacked pull requests (#42).
changed: The version is 1.2.1 in pyproject.toml, src/agent_ledger/__init__.py, uv.lock and the README's status line.

claims.claim: The suite passes at 1.2.1 and the CLI reports the new version.
claims.check: cd tests && python3.12 -m unittest discover -s .; ledger --version from src

next.item: Tag v1.2.1 on this PR's merge commit, publish the release, and bump curator's ledger-verify pin from f77709d to it
next.why_now: curator's stacked pull requests fail ledger-verify until its pin includes #42.
next.impact: A red ledger-verify on a curator pull request means a real ledger problem again, not a stack.

release.note: 1.2.1: the ledger-verify Action no longer fails a pull request stacked on another one. It checks the stack against the newest base-branch commit it contains, so main's ledgers must still stay append-only (#42).
